openings.claim: A decision-bound frontier may improve scarce adjudication informativeness over largest-apparent-gain-slice priority. Replace provisional confusion counts with per-record uncertainty intervals: identical predictions contribute zero regardless of label; unresolved flagged differing predictions contribute conservatively from minus one to plus one. Aggregate total/slice bounds; select the flagged row whose possible resolutions most change acceptance-clause certification, breaking ties by record identifier.
openings.discriminator: Compare against fixed flagged-row ordering from the largest apparent-gain slice first. Frontier selection may certify more supported decisions within sixteen adjudications: frozen supported verdict versus unresolved, checked against the full-label key. Hypothetical advantage is defeated by withheld influential rows, equivalent rival selections, or bounds remaining inconclusive after allowed work.
openings.probe: Use only supplied records/labels. Run both policies on matched copies with independently reset sixteen-row allowances and the same four preselected withheld rows. Log identifier, selection reason, access outcome, adjudication count and elapsed time; attempted withheld access consumes no allowance. Advance only if total lower bound is at least four and every slice lower bound at least minus two. Reject only if total upper bound is below four or some slice upper bound below minus two. Otherwise continue until sixteen adjudications or seventy minutes, then report unresolved and affected slices. Freeze both reports before opening the sealed full-label key; compare supported-verdict correctness, unresolved outcomes, adjudications and time.
openings.uncertainty: Unflagged supplied labels are fixed review inputs; flagged labels carry uncertainty. Conservative bounds may remain inconclusive when joint analysis could decide. Resources are synthetic stipulations. No certification, observed advantage or deployment readiness is promised; uncertainty at the work limit remains reportable.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, rival, defeat conditions, assumptions, limits and declared preserves fit.

decision: Retain one bounded workflow hypothesis for comparison; supplied evidence does not establish its advantage or an actual advance/reject verdict.
